title: Flow Matching for Offline Reinforcement Learning with Discrete Actions
abstract: arXiv:2602.06138v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative policies based on diffusion models and flow matching have shown strong promise for offline reinforcement learning (RL), but their applicability remains largely confined to continuous action spaces. To address a broader range of offline RL settings, we extend flow matching to a general framework that supports discrete action spaces with multiple objectives. Specifically, we replace continuous flows with continuous-time Markov chains, trained using a Q-weighted flow matching objective. We then extend our design to multi-agent settings, mitigating the exponential growth of joint action spaces via a factorized conditional path. For an oracle single policy-improvement step from the behavior distribution, we theoretically show that, under idealized conditions, the Q-weighted objective recovers the KL-regularized Boltzmann policy. translated_title: 面向离散动作离线强化学习的流匹配方法
translated_abstract: 基于扩散模型和流匹配的生成式策略在离线强化学习（RL）中展现出了强大的潜力，但其适用性在很大程度上仍局限于连续动作空间。为了应对更广泛的离线RL场景，我们将流匹配扩展为一个支持具有多个目标的离散动作空间的通用框架。具体而言，我们用连续时间马尔可夫链替代连续流，并采用Q加权流匹配目标进行训练。随后，我们将该设计扩展到多智能体设置，通过分解式条件路径缓解联合动作空间的指数级增长问题。对于从行为分布出发的单步策略改进（oracle），我们在理论上证明，在理想化条件下，Q加权目标能够恢复出KL正则化的玻尔兹曼策略。大量实验表明，我们的方法在多种设置和基准测试中均表现出稳健的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出将流匹配扩展为支持离散动作空间的离线强化学习通用框架，通过连续时间马尔可夫链与Q加权流匹配目标实现策略学习，并借助分解式条件路径将其推广到多智能体场景，同时给出了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper extends flow matching into a general framework for offline RL with discrete actions, using continuous-time Markov chains trained with a Q-weighted objective, further scaling to multi-agent settings via factorized conditional paths, and providing theoretical guarantees.
